newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New HK airport charges may nearly double--official.
newsitem.headline: New HK airport charges may nearly double--official.

text.p: Hong Kong's Airport Authority said on Friday it has proposed nearly doubling charges airlines will pay at the new Hong Kong airport compared to those of the current airport.

"Our charges will be slightly less than twice than those now levied at the existing airport," said Henry Townsend, chief executive of the Airport Authority, which is developing Hong Kong's new airport at Chek Lap Kok.
The charges include landing fees, parking fees and passenger terminal fees, he told a business luncheon.
